description:
DECISIONS APPROVED by the owner on 2026-09-28 (no further sign-off needed). This item only records them durably.

D1 Trunk stays `develop`.
D2 REPLACE the publication control plane now (not keep): build site-deploy meeting the entry criteria in dlv2-60, cut over, then retire the whole plane in dlv2-62.
D3 Results corpus homes unchanged (results-data/ + published-results).
D4 Soundness hold = agent policy + CI flag: ci.yml `tooling` flags PRs touching soundness paths; agents may enqueue them only after a dedicated external adversarial review (codex, muse, or agy) whose findings are resolved and linked in the PR. The ruleset's code-owner review stays as-is but is NOT relied on (approval count is 0 and agents act as the owner; PR #2416 touched owned paths and merged with no review decision).
D5 Keep agent worktree/identity/trailer tooling and todo-state; retire agent PR-loop tooling.
D6 Codecov kept, informational.
D7 Ruleset drift detection kept inside ci.yml `tooling` and the release workflow.
Tags: no signature requirement; release safety relies on the v-tag-restricted ruleset, tag commit passed the merge queue, artifact hash match, and build provenance attestation.

STANDING APPROVALS (agent acts without stopping once an item's preconditions are met; back up first per G5):
- Rulesets and merge queue changes (add/remove required checks, queue 5->3 / 5->3 / 60->30 min, delete release-only).
- Branches: delete `release` and `publication` after archive tags; stale gh-readonly-queue/* with no live entry; auto-revert/*; head branches of merged/closed PRs.
- Labels and environments: delete legacy incident/no-auto-merge labels, create quarantine and t3:* labels, delete publication-attestation environment after the replacement.
- Secrets and App: delete PUBLICATION_APP_ID/PRIVATE_KEY and uninstall the publication App after the replacement; delete TODO_DB_URL, TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN, TODO_EXPORT_PR_TOKEN if no repo reference exists.
- Merging: agent enqueues/merges its own dlv2 PRs after CI, self-review, and (soundness paths) external adversarial review.
- github-pages deployments: agent approves pending deployments via the API after its pre-deploy gates pass.
- Releases: agent runs the TestPyPI rehearsal only. The real PyPI release (version 0.4.2) is triggered or approved by the owner; the agent STOPS there.
- t3:cloud: wire it behind a repo variable defaulting to off; never run live cloud tests.
- T2 budget miss: add shards on standard runners up to 10; if still over 15 min, accept up to 20 min and record it. No paid larger runners.
- Waiting windows (5 working days shadow, 7 nights, 20 green queue runs): work other ready items meanwhile; otherwise set not_before and schedule a wake-up. Not a stop.
- External: file the upstream chdb issue.
The agent stops only for unexpected situations and for the owner-controlled PyPI release.
